content.text:
**Status: complete.** All seven items are implemented test-first and the checks pass. Nothing is committed or pushed. No rendered screenshots exist and nothing ran against real Gmail, OAuth or the Keychain, so there are no visual results to report.

## Checks
- `pnpm test`: 59 files passed, 4 skipped (the opt-in rendered tests), and 1024 tests passed with 33 skipped. The baseline was 943 passed.
- `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build`: clean. No Rust was touched, so cargo was skipped. `generated.ts` is untouched.

## Per item: tests that failed before and pass after
Before-state failures were captured by running the new tests against the unchanged code, so they are real regressions caught, not after-the-fact tests.

1. **Empty state (P0).**
   - Before, a Gmail inbox with no rows always printed "No conversations are currently in the inbox…" (`first sync failed` saw it instead of "Sync failed: The network is unavailable.").
   - Now it branches per account state and per Gmail mode, including the read-only wording. This is covered by `account-status.test.ts` (19 tests) and 9 tests in `tests/account.first-run.component.test.ts`. They cover not_configured (no Connect, link to Account), disconnected, auth_required, authenticating, syncing, failed, unfinished, genuinely empty (read-only and enabled), and the starred filter and fixture mode staying unchanged.
   - Focus stays on the `inbox-empty` element, or lands on a row after Connect.
2. **Reachability.** The `reachability with no account` test confirms the rail entry, the palette entries and the empty-state Connect all exist and work. Gating is unchanged.
3. **Header status note.** 6 tests: `account-status-note` shows each connection and sync state, "Offline" only for `network_unavailable`, and never says actions are off. The read-only hint steps aside only for connection notes. The hidden text does not change as the cached count ticks, so it is not re-announced.
4. **AccountPanel.** The 20 tests in the new `tests/account-panel.component.test.ts` failed 17/20 before. They cover:
   - the four sections, the connection line and the mode line;
   - the singular/plural count and the short coverage line;
   - the sync-error alert with its inline Retry;
   - the shorter scope disclosure and the "Cancel permission request" button;
   - the two-step Disconnect, including focus handling, Esc and IME guards, and a reset when the account goes away.
5. **ProviderDestinations.** 12 of 17 failed before. They cover:
   - classes with no scoped `<style>`, the intro line, the loading line placed before the list, and plain errors;
   - ArrowDown/ArrowUp and j/k with a roving tab stop;
   - j/k not stolen from the search field (ArrowDown there enters the list);
   - Escape stepping reader, page list, catalog, then out to App.
6. **Copy and CSS.** One banner test in `workspaces.component.test.ts` failed before. "Loading account…" is changed with no dedicated test (the `account-loading` hook is unchanged).
7. **Keys.** `connect`/`sync` palette presence and absence, plus 6 `g a` tests in `g-chord.component.test.ts`. 3 of those failed with `a` disabled; the other 3 pin existing behaviour (hint wording, fixture mode, `g e`).

## Existing assertions I changed
- **`account.component.test.ts`.**
  - The disposable-note assertion became "absent", and the mode title is checked instead.
  - Mode text 'Permission upgrade' became 'permission request pending'.
  - 'Disconnected' became 'Not connected'.
  - 'Sign-in required' became 'Sign-in expired'.
  - The retained-account button text 'Disconnect' became 'Disconnect…', and its click now confirms.
  - The coverage test now expects the exact line "Up to 100 conversations are cached; older mail may be missing." and checks the "7 conversations cached" count separately, because the count moved to the sync line.
  - The "cancel sign-in" test now also asserts there is no confirm step.
- **Disconnect confirm.**
  - `helpers.ts` gets a `confirmDisconnect` helper.
  - `drafts.component.test.ts` (3 places) and `discovery.component.test.ts` use it, because Disconnect now needs two clicks.
  - The drafts "warning" test now asserts the warning is absent until asked.
- **`drafts.component.test.ts` race.** One test waited only for the Connect button to exist. It now also waits until the button is enabled, since Connect is correctly disabled during the account transition.
- **`stars.component.test.ts`.** The 'upgrade in progress' expectation became 'permission request pending'.
- **`provider-destinations.component.test.ts`.** The raw `network_unavailable` expectation became the plain sentence.
- **`provider-destinations.app.test.ts`.** Two flows gained one Escape level (page list, then catalog, then drawer), as the new spec requires.

## Files
- **Source:** `src/lib/account-status.ts` (new), `src/App.vue`, `src/components/AccountPanel.vue`, `src/components/ProviderDestinations.vue`, `src/FixtureWorkspaces.vue`, `src/lib/browsing-actions.ts`, `src/assets/style.css`.
- **Small additions outside your list:** `src/lib/action-palette.ts` (the type map requires a group and aliases for the new actions, so I added an "Account" palette group) and `src/components/CommandGlyph.vue` (a sync glyph).
- **Docs:** `DESIGN.md` (gap 18, plus fixes to gap 1, the gap 10 rule list, Buttons and palette groups), `docs/development.md`, `docs/ux-03-command-discovery.md`.
- **Tests:** the new files `tests/account-status.test.ts`, `tests/account-panel.component.test.ts` and `tests/account.first-run.component.test.ts`, and edits to the existing files named above (plus `workspaces.component.test.ts` and `g-chord.component.test.ts`).

## Judgment calls you may want to check
- **Workspace switch title.** The "Switch account — also in Commands" title is only on the inactive account's button, since a switch-to-self title would mislead.
- **not_configured note.** The header note says "Gmail not configured · Account", and the palette `connect` command stays available there, because you specified the same rules as the Account buttons.
- **Cancel sign-in.** The inline Cancel is hidden (not shown disabled) while a connect call is in flight. That call does not resolve until the browser flow completes, so a sign-in that never finishes cannot be cancelled from the UI. The Account drawer's Cancel has the same limit. I recorded it in DESIGN.md.
- **Initial-sync line.** I added one small line, "Initial sync has not finished.", to the Account Sync section for connected, idle and unfinished states, matching the empty-inbox line. It was not asked for.

## Not verified
Rendered spacing and truncation of the header note at narrow widths, and screen-reader announcements. Real Google OAuth, real sync and native offline behaviour, and the macOS Keychain, were not run.
